comparison.objective: Register an aluminum block flat and square against both faces of a corner stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hand-off, planar pose correction, and two-face contact registration; no impact, intentional breakage, or small-object recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Full score requires at most 1 mm gaps, at most 2 degrees angular error, flatness within stated limits, and 1 s stillness.
comparison.reason: Tests fixture registration of an intact workpiece rather than stabilizing a mandrel, delivering a controlled blow, and accounting for every released tang.
